quiz.ar: أسعار النحاس قفزت بقوة في أسبوع واحد.

book: As you can see from this graph, the cost of healthcare in the US has been steadily increasing over the past decade.

family.ex: Now I'd like to open the floor to questions about the UPS offer.
family.ar: دلوقتي حابب أفتح باب الأسئلة عن عرض الـ‎UPS‎.
family.ex2: Please keep them short.

family.ex: The floor is yours, Eng. Hossam.
family.ar: الكلمة ليك يا باشمهندس ‎Hossam‎.
family.ex2: Tell us about the site survey.

family.ex: The client's IT manager will take the floor after our presentation.
family.ar: مدير الـ‎IT‎ عند العميل هياخد الكلمة بعد عرضنا.
family.ex2: He wants to ask about lithium options.

syn.note: simple and common at the end of talks
syn.ex: I'll take questions now.
syn.ar: هاخد الأسئلة دلوقتي.

syn.note: formal; ask people to give their views
syn.ex: We invite comments on the draft contract.
syn.ar: بنطلب تعليقاتكم على مسودة العقد.

ant.ex: Let's close the discussion and decide.

ctx: That's the end of the technical part. Let me open the floor now: any questions about the batteries, the warranty or the delivery?
ctx_ar: ده آخر الجزء الفني. خلّيني أفتح باب الأسئلة دلوقتي: فيه أسئلة عن البطاريات أو الضمان أو التسليم؟

quiz.s: I'd like to ___ the floor for questions.
quiz.ar: حابب أفتح باب الأسئلة.

quiz.s: Thank you, Mona. The ___ is yours.
quiz.ar: شكرًا يا ‎Mona‎. الكلمة ليكي.

quiz.s: We have no time left, so let's ___ the discussion.
quiz.ar: مفيش وقت فاضل، فيلا نقفل النقاش.

book: Before we move on, I want to open the floor for any questions or comments you may have.
